### GET /v2/catalog/traits

List traits

Keyset-paginated character traits. Anonymous calls are allowed and limited per IP address; an application key or a user access token with catalog:read gets its own, higher limit. ids= is a batch lane. refs= is not resolved: traits have no catalog_external_ref entity_type. parent_id= lists direct children; group_id= lists traits in that root group (the root excluded); root=true|false keeps only roots or only non-roots. Filters are conjunctive. Without nsfw=true, sexual-family traits are excluded from the list and land in missing[] on the ids= batch; naming one as parent_id or group_id is 400. include=aliases,description,intros (and view=full) add those blocks. include=character_count is the nightly index total that GET /v2/catalog/characters?trait_id=<this id>&page=1 answers under this request's nsfw; the engine failing is 503. It is an explicit ask: view=full does not add it. is_sexual reports the sexual-family flag.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：可匿名调用
- scope：catalog:read（仅在带凭据时）

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `parent_id` | query | 否 | string | Catalog trait id. Direct children of this trait only. Naming a sexual-family trait without nsfw=true is 400. |
| `group_id` | query | 否 | string | Catalog trait id of a root group. Traits in that group, excluding the root itself. Naming a sexual-family trait without nsfw=true is 400. |
| `root` | query | 否 | string | true: only root traits. false: only non-root traits. Only true or false. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/catalog/traits"
```

### GET /v2/catalog/works

List catalog works

Keyset-paginated work collection. q= switches to search (sort defaults to relevance). company_id=/tag_id=/series_id= filter the live registry when q= is absent. exclude_tag_id=/exclude_tag_tree= drop works by tag on every lane, search included. Anonymous calls are allowed and limited per IP address; an application key or a user access token with catalog:read gets its own, higher limit. view/include/fields/ids/refs/facets follow the v2 collection contract. include= takes titles, refs, intros, covers, companies, ratings, tags, credits, playtimes. view=full is titles, refs, intros, covers, companies, ratings, tags; credits, playtimes come only when include= names them. Every block fills on every lane, the ids=/refs= batch lane included. On a collection lane titles elects latin/localized and covers elects the two cover slots that grade the base cover — the full titles[] and covers[] arrays, and relations, releases, popularity, series, platforms, screenshots, characters, engines, links, are per-record blocks and live on /v2/catalog/works/{id} and its sub-resources; asking for one here is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. page= selects page mode (see the page parameter). sort=rating_bangumi, rating_vndb, rating_erogamescape, rating_dlsite, rating_nextmoe each rank by one source's rating, highest first, and read the search index, which is rebuilt nightly. Sources are never combined; each keeps its own scale. bangumi, erogamescape and dlsite rank by (10·m + n·score) / (10 + n), where n is that source's vote_count and m its mean score over the indexed works, which pulls a work with few votes toward m; vndb and nextmoe already publish a Bayesian score and rank by it as published. Works the source has not rated come last, and ties break by id ascending.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：可匿名调用
- scope：catalog:read（仅在带凭据时）

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `q` | query | 否 | string | Work title search. Switches this collection to the search index; sort defaults to relevance. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `content_rating` | query | 否 | string | Closed: all_ages, sensitive, r18. r18 requires nsfw=true. |
| `claimed` | query | 否 | string | true or false. Absent = no gate. |
| `claim_state` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated closed states: none, live, draft. pending, declined and hidden are the per-site moderation queue: they need a key holding claim_events:read and a site= naming the caller's own site, and are otherwise not in the vocabulary. |
| `content_limit` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated closed editorial axis: sfw, nsfw. |
| `site` | query | 否 | string | Claiming site key. Open vocabulary; unknown values match nothing. |
| `owner_uid` | query | 否 | string | The claiming site's own user id of the claim owner. Requires site=. Live registry filter; cannot be combined with q=, page= or search sorts. |
| `company_id` | query | 否 | string | Catalog company id. Live registry filter when q= is absent. |
| `company_rollup` | query | 否 | string | true expands company_id one hop down imprint/subsidiary. Only true or false. |
| `tag_id` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated canonical tag ids, AND, max 10. |
| `exclude_tag_id` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated canonical tag ids, max 100. Drops every work that carries any of them, from any source and at any spoiler level. ANDed with the other filters, tag_id included: a tag named in both leaves nothing. |
| `exclude_tag_tree` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated canonical tag ids, max 100. As exclude_tag_id, and each id also drops the works carrying any tag below it in the tag hierarchy (Tag.descendant_count counts them). |
| `series_id` | query | 否 | string | Catalog series id. |
| `engine_id` | query | 否 | string | Catalog engine id. |
| `platform` | query | 否 | string | Open vocabulary platform token. Unknown matches nothing. |
| `released_after` | query | 否 | string | YYYY-MM-DD inclusive, earliest release per work. |
| `released_before` | query | 否 | string | YYYY-MM-DD inclusive, earliest release per work. |
| `olang` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated BCP-47, or all. Open vocabulary; unknown values match nothing. Absent = no language gate. |
| `page` | query | 否 | string | 1-based page number. Selects page mode: the response carries total and total_relation and no next_cursor. page times limit may not exceed 10000; the last reachable page is min(ceil(total/limit), floor(10000/limit)). Cannot be combined with cursor, ids or refs. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/catalog/works"
```

### GET /v2/catalog/works/{id}

Get one catalog work

Work detail. spoiler=none|minor|major is the ceiling of the tags block and defaults to none. Merged ids are 404 ENTITY_MERGED with Link rel=canonical. r18 is 404 without nsfw=true. Anonymous calls are allowed and limited per IP address; an application key or a user access token with catalog:read gets its own, higher limit. include= takes titles, refs, relations, credits, releases, popularity, ratings, tags, playtimes, series, platforms, intros, covers, screenshots, characters, companies, engines, links. view=full is titles, refs, intros, covers, companies, tags, releases, ratings, relations, engines, series, links; credits, popularity, playtimes, platforms, screenshots, characters come only when include= names them.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：可匿名调用
- scope：catalog:read（仅在带凭据时）

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | 是 | string | Decimal catalog id. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `spoiler` | query | 否 | string | Spoiler ceiling for the tags block: none (default), minor or major. Closed vocabulary; an unknown value is 400. Tag rows above the ceiling are not returned. Only the VNDB-derived tag vocabulary carries a spoiler level — Bangumi and DLsite folksonomy publish no spoiler concept, so those rows read none — and the default is the safe ceiling. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/catalog/works/1"
```

## 资讯

### GET /v2/news

List news items

Published news feed. Keyset-paginated. Unauthenticated. Attribution fields are required on every item. lane=, source=, published_after= and published_before= narrow the population, and include_total= counts the narrowed one. ids= and refs= are not accepted.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：无需凭据
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `lane` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated closed lanes: news, column. Absent means both. An unknown lane is 400 UNKNOWN_ENUM_VALUE. |
| `source` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated news source keys, at most 20. Open vocabulary; an unknown key matches nothing rather than failing. |
| `published_after` | query | 否 | string | Inclusive lower bound on published_at. RFC 3339 UTC ending in Z. |
| `published_before` | query | 否 | string | Inclusive upper bound on published_at. RFC 3339 UTC ending in Z. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/news"
```

### GET /v2/news/sources

List news sources

Every attributed news source. Unauthenticated.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：无需凭据
- scope：无需凭据

无参数。

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/news/sources"
```

### GET /v2/news/{id}

Get one news item

A published news item. A withdrawn item is 410 GONE, not 404: a mirror that only sees the item leave the list never learns the copy it took was pulled. An item that never existed, or is still pending, is 404. Unauthenticated. source and source_url are always present; source_url is the empty string for an original community submission, which carries body instead.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：无需凭据
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | 是 | string | Decimal news item id. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/news/1"
```

## 公开收藏夹

### GET /v2/folders

List a user's public folders

The public favorite folders of one account, id-ascending. owner_uid is required: there is no platform-wide folder directory. Private folders never appear here, not even for their own owner — /v2/me/folders is that face. Requires an application key or a user access token with catalog:read.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_…
- scope：catalog:read

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `owner_uid` | query | 否 | string | Required. The account whose public folders to list — the central sign-in user id, the same one a folder reports as owner_uid. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/folders" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_<YOUR_KEY>"
```

### GET /v2/folders/holders

Who holds this work in a folder

The accounts that keep one work in a favorite folder, owner_uid-ascending, one page at a time. Folders of every visibility count: this face exists so a service can fan a notification out to the people who follow a work, and a private folder is still a person waiting to hear about it. It answers uids and nothing else — no folder ids, names, visibility or counts — so it cannot be walked into a "who favourited what" index. A work nobody holds is an empty list, not a 404. Requires an application key with the folder_holders:read scope on top of catalog:read; a user access token is refused. The scope is granted by an operator, not self-service, because the answer is somebody else's private collection.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_…
- scope：catalog:read + folder_holders:read

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `work_id` | query | 否 | string | Catalog work id. Required. |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 100. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/folders/holders" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_<YOUR_KEY>"
```

### GET /v2/folders/{id}

Get one public folder

404 when no folder with this id is public, whether it does not exist or its owner keeps it private. owner_uid names the account it belongs to. Requires an application key or a user access token with catalog:read.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_…
- scope：catalog:read

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_<YOUR_KEY>"
```

### GET /v2/folders/{id}/items

List a public folder's items

Keyset-paginated by updated_at, the same shape /v2/me/folders/{id}/items answers. The list carries every work the folder holds and applies no editorial gate, so item_count matches what is returned; a caller that hides r18 applies its own gate when it hydrates the works. Requires an application key or a user access token with catalog:read.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_…
- scope：catalog:read

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |

| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/folders/1/items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_<YOUR_KEY>"
```

## 公开评分

### GET /v2/ratings

List ratings of a work or by an account

Newest first by creation, so an edit does not move a rating. work_id= or user_id= is required, and both together answer the one rating that account gave that work. No editorial gate applies: a caller that hides r18 works filters when it hydrates them. Requires an application key or a user access token with catalog:read.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_…
- scope：catalog:read

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `work_id` | query | 否 | string | The ratings of one work. At least one of work_id and user_id is required. |
| `user_id` | query | 否 | string | The ratings one account wrote — the central sign-in user id. At least one of work_id and user_id is required. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/ratings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_<YOUR_KEY>"
```

### GET /v2/ratings/changes

Rating changes feed

Every rating written or deleted on any NextMoe site, oldest first, keyset-paginated. **This is the mirror channel** for a site that keeps its own copy of the ratings: bootstrap from an empty cursor (the first drain is the whole population), then poll at your own cadence. next_cursor comes only with a full page, so keep the last one you received and poll from it: the partial page after it is read again, which an upsert absorbs. A written entry carries the rating as it stands; an entry with gone: true is a deletion, so drop the mirrored row. A change surfaces five seconds after it commits. ids= is not accepted. Requires an application key or a user access token with catalog:read.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_…
- scope：catalog:read

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/ratings/changes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_<YOUR_KEY>"
```

## 公开游玩记录

### GET /v2/work-records

List an account's play records

The works one account has a play state on — wish, doing, done, on_hold or dropped — each with its playtime and rating, the shape /v2/me/work-records/{work_id} answers its owner. This is the face a profile page's game library reads. Newest first by the play state's updated_at; a work with only a playtime or only a rating is not listed. Works that are no longer live in the catalog are left out. facets=state counts the works per state after the same filters as the items, state= included, as every v2 facet does: all five states are present, 0 when empty. Ask for it on a request without state= to fill a row of tabs. include_total counts the items. An account that keeps its play records private (PATCH /v2/me/privacy) is 403 PLAY_RECORDS_PRIVATE, except to its own user token; the account reads its own list, private or not, on /v2/me/work-records, which needs no scope. Play records are public by default. Requires an application key or a user access token with catalog:read.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_…
- scope：catalog:read

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `state` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated closed vocabulary: wish, doing, done, on_hold, dropped. Absent lists every state. |
| `content_limit` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated closed editorial axis: sfw, nsfw, as on /v2/catalog/works. Absent applies no gate. total and the state facet count after it, so a reader who hides nsfw works gets counts that match what it shows. |
| `user_id` | query | 是 | string | The account whose play records to list — the central sign-in user id, the same one a rating reports as user_id. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/work-records" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nmk_live_<YOUR_KEY>"
```

## 我的

### GET /v2/me/blocked-tags

List my blocked tags

The bearer user's blocked tags, newest first. Items carry ids only and are hydrated with /v2/catalog/tags?ids=. tag_ids= is a batch read. The list is private to its owner and the catalog applies none of it by itself: a client sends the tree ids in exclude_tag_tree and the exact ids in exclude_tag_id on /v2/catalog/works and the two calendars. At most 100 entries, so the whole list always fits those parameters. Requires a user access token. Any app may call this; no scope is required.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `tag_ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated tag ids, max 100. Batch read, no pagination. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/blocked-tags" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### PUT /v2/me/blocked-tags/{tag_id}

Block a tag

Optional body {mode}: tree (the default) or exact. Sets the mode of an existing block and otherwise writes nothing for it. Unknown tags are 404. At most 100 blocked tags. Requires a user access token. Any app may call this; no scope is required.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tag_id` | path | 是 | string | Catalog tag id. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | 否 | string | tree (the default) also blocks every tag below this one in the tag hierarchy; exact blocks this tag only. 取值：tree \| exact |

```bash
curl -X PUT "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/blocked-tags/1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"mode":"tree"}'
```

### GET /v2/me/calendar

My release calendar

The bearer's release calendar: the works of the companies they follow, with the same windows, parameters and meta as /v2/catalog/calendar. Absent olang means all languages and absent exclude_company_kind excludes nothing, because the population is already the bearer's choice; the public calendar's defaults (Japanese, commercial only) would hide a followed doujin circle or a Chinese company. A user who follows no company gets an empty window. Requires a user access token. Any app may call this; no scope is required. ids= is not accepted. include=titles,refs,intros,covers,companies,ratings,tags,credits fills on this lane; view=full is all of them except credits, which is an explicit ask. On a collection lane titles elects latin/localized and covers elects the two cover slots that grade the base cover — the full titles[] and covers[] arrays, and relations/releases/popularity/playtimes/series/platforms/screenshots/characters/engines/links, are per-record blocks and live on /v2/catalog/works/{id} and its sub-resources; asking for one here is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `month` | query | 否 | string | Dated month window YYYY-MM. Default: current month in Asia/Tokyo. |
| `year` | query | 否 | string | Year-only window YYYY (v1 pending). Default with precision=year: current year in Asia/Tokyo. |
| `precision` | query | 否 | string | day, month, or year. year selects the year-only window. day and month use the dated month window. |
| `status` | query | 否 | string | released, dated, announced, cancelled, unknown. announced and unknown select the undated window. cancelled is empty until the catalog records cancellations. |
| `content_limit` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated closed editorial axis: sfw, nsfw. |
| `olang` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated BCP-47, or all. Open vocabulary; unknown values match nothing. Absent = all languages. The population is already the bearer's choice, so this face does not default to ja. |
| `exclude_company_kind` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated closed company_kind values: game_brand, bunko, publisher, anime_studio, doujin_circle, group, or none alone to exclude nothing. Drops a work only when it has at least one company and every one of its companies is of an excluded kind; a work that also carries a company of another kind stays, and so does a work with no company. Applies to the page, total, and the month navigation in meta. Absent = exclude nothing. The population is already the bearer's choice, so this face does not default to doujin_circle. |
| `exclude_tag_id` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated canonical tag ids, max 100. Drops every work that carries any of them, from any source and at any spoiler level. Applies to the page, total, and the month navigation in meta. |
| `exclude_tag_tree` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated canonical tag ids, max 100. As exclude_tag_id, and each id also drops the works carrying any tag below it in the tag hierarchy (Tag.descendant_count counts them). |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/calendar" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### GET /v2/me/claims

List my claims

Claims the bearer acted on. kind=submitted (the default) keeps the ones the bearer owns, kind=audited the ones the bearer only reviewed, kind=all everything they touched. claim_state= and site= narrow further, and site= also scopes first_acted_at/acted_count. Requires a user access token. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `claim_state` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated closed states: none, live, draft, pending, declined, hidden. |
| `kind` | query | 否 | string | submitted (default) keeps works the bearer owns, audited keeps works the bearer reviewed but does not own, all keeps everything the bearer touched. |
| `site` | query | 否 | string | Claiming site key. Open vocabulary; unknown values match nothing. Also scopes first_acted_at and acted_count. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/claims" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### POST /v2/me/claims

Submit a claim

Mint or claim a work. work_id claims an existing catalog work. refs= claims the work they resolve to, or mints one from display_name when none match. site_work_id with display_name and neither work_id nor refs mints a work anchored to the site's own id. field_values carries an editing-engine work field map onto any mint lane and may be sent alone, without work_id, refs or site_work_id; it is refused with work_id, and refs that already resolve to a work answer 409 instead of dropping it. released rides the same mint lanes under the same two refusals and becomes one curated catalog_release row on the minted work. A caller holding catalog.claim.trusted mints straight to live rather than pending. A mint whose display_name or catalog.work.titles match live works of the same medium is refused with 409 DUPLICATE_SUSPECTS naming them in suspects[] and nothing is written; re-send with confirm_duplicates=true to mint anyway. The claiming lanes — work_id, and refs that resolve — never hit this gate. A contributor who has used up catalog.claim_writes_per_day inside the sliding window is refused 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED; holders of catalog.claim.trusted get the higher catalog.claim_writes_per_day_trusted. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | 否 | string | Makes the request safe to retry. The same key with the same body within 24 hours replays the first response with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a retry while the first request is still running is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS. Scoped to the caller and the path. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `confirm_duplicates` | 否 | boolean | Mint even when live works of the same medium share a submitted title. Without it such a mint is refused with 409 DUPLICATE_SUSPECTS and the works in suspects[]; nothing is written. Confirming still files the pairs for reconciliation. Only mint lanes read this. |
| `display_name` | 否 | string | Required to mint when refs do not match. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `field_values` | 否 | map<string, object> | Editing-engine field key to value for the minted work, e.g. catalog.work.titles — the same shape GET /v2/moderation/snapshots/{object}/{id} answers. Sent alone it mints from the map; sent with work_id it is 422. Top-level display_name wins over catalog.work.display_name. |
| `field_values.«key»` | 否 | object |  |
| `refs` | 否 | object[] | source:external_id anchors, at most 100. Used when work_id is absent. |
| `refs[].external_id` | 是 | string | Verbatim upstream id. Must not be used as a discriminant beyond exact match. |
| `refs[].source` | 是 | string | Open vocabulary source key such as vndb. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `released` | 否 | object |  |
| `released.d` | 否 | integer (int32) | Release day; 0 or absent means unknown. Requires m. |
| `released.m` | 否 | integer (int32) | Release month; 0 or absent means unknown. |
| `released.y` | 是 | integer (int32) | Release year. |
| `site_work_id` | 否 | string | The site's own work id. Sent alone with display_name — no work_id, no refs — it mints a work anchored to that id. |
| `work_id` | 否 | string | Existing catalog work id to claim. |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/claims" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"work_id":"1"}'
```

### GET /v2/me/claims/{id}

Get one of my claims

id is the catalog work id. Requires a user access token. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

### PATCH /v2/me/claims/{id}

Move a claim the caller owns

PATCH {state: live|pending|withdrawn}. live publishes a draft without review, pending submits it for review, withdrawn returns it to draft. The owner may act, and an unowned claim is adopted by its first claimant. Counts against the same catalog.claim_writes_per_day window as a mint, and answers 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED when it is exhausted. If-Match required. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | 是 | string | Catalog work id. |
| `If-Match` | header | 是 | string | Current ETag. Required; its absence is 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | 是 | string | live publishes a draft, pending submits it for review, withdrawn returns a live or pending claim to draft. draft is the older spelling of withdrawn. 取值：live \| pending \| withdrawn \| draft |

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/claims/1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"live"}'
```

### DELETE /v2/me/claims/{id}

Delete a draft claim

Deletes a draft the caller owns; a live or pending claim must be withdrawn to draft first (PATCH state=withdrawn). This soft-deletes the catalog work row and writes no claim event. 204 with no body. Requires a user access token. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | 是 | string | Catalog work id. |

```bash
curl -X DELETE "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/claims/1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### POST /v2/me/creations

Propose a new entry

Files a proposal that creates a new entry of one family. It is reviewed like any proposal (it appears in GET /v2/moderation/proposals with entity_id 0 and a creation block) unless the create policy lets the bearer apply it at once; once merged, entity_id is the new entry's id. Entries whose normalized name already exists are refused with 409 DUPLICATE_SUSPECTS unless confirm_duplicates=true. Counts against the same proposal quota as POST /v2/me/proposals. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | 否 | string | Makes the request safe to retry. The same key with the same body within 24 hours replays the first response with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a retry while the first request is still running is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS. Scoped to the caller and the path. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `confirm_duplicates` | 否 | boolean | Create even when entries with the same normalized name exist. Without it such a request is refused with 409 DUPLICATE_SUSPECTS naming them, and nothing is written. |
| `note` | 否 | string | Proposer's own summary. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `object` | 是 | string | Family of the new entry. Works are created through POST /v2/me/claims. Tags and traits take a reviewer-only create policy. 取值：company \| character \| release \| engine \| series \| person \| credit_name \| tag \| trait |
| `params` | 否 | map<string, object> | Creation parameters; /v2/me/edit-capabilities/{object} creation.param_specs lists them (release takes work_id, person takes credit_name_id of an unattributed credit name). |
| `params.«key»` | 否 | object |  |
| `patch` | 否 | map<string, object> | Field key to initial value, the same keys and values POST /v2/me/proposals accepts for that family. creation.required_fields must be present. |
| `patch.«key»` | 否 | object |  |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/creations" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"object":"company"}'
```

### GET /v2/me/deletion-preview

Preview what a deletion affects

What deleting the entry would touch: its links to source entries, releases, user records that would be hidden, open edit proposals that would be declined, the claiming site, and any pending request. Also answers for an entry that is already deleted. Requires a user access token bound to a first-party catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `object` | query | 否 | string | Family of the entry. 取值：work |
| `target_id` | query | 否 | string | The entry. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/deletion-preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### GET /v2/me/deletion-requests

List my deletion requests

The bearer's own deletion requests, newest first; follow next_cursor for more. Requires a user access token bound to a first-party catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | query | 否 | string | Narrow to one state. 取值：open \| approved \| executed \| rejected \| withdrawn \| restored |
| `target_id` | query | 否 | string | Narrow to requests about one work. |
| `origin_site` | query | 否 | string | Narrow to requests filed from one first-party property. 取值：kungal \| moyu \| letmoe \| nextmoe \| editor |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from next_cursor. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | integer (int64) | Page size, 1-100. Default 20. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/deletion-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### POST /v2/me/deletion-requests

Request a deletion

Asks reviewers to delete a catalog entry; only works can be deleted today. Nothing is deleted on filing: a reviewer approves, the cooling-off runs, then the entry is soft-deleted. Its links to source entries stay as a tombstone so the importers do not create it again, and user records on it are kept but hidden until a reviewer restores it under the same id. A duplicate is refused 422: merge it with /v2/me/merge-requests instead. One open or approved request per entry; another is 409. Quotas are tiered: catalog.deletion_requests_per_day, _editor, _reviewer inside catalog.write_quota_window_hours; past it 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Requires a user access token bound to a first-party catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | 否 | string | Makes the request safe to retry. The same key with the same body within 24 hours replays the first response with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a retry while the first request is still running is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS. Scoped to the caller and the path. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | 是 | string | Evidence reviewers can check. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `object` | 是 | string | Family of the entry. Only works can be deleted today. 取值：work |
| `reason` | 是 | string | Why it should go. duplicate is refused 422: a duplicate is merged into the entry it duplicates through /v2/me/merge-requests. 取值：not_a_work \| out_of_scope \| spam_or_test \| other \| duplicate |
| `target_id` | 是 | string | The entry to delete. |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/deletion-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"note":"string","object":"work","reason":"not_a_work","target_id":"1"}'
```

### PATCH /v2/me/deletion-requests/{id}

Withdraw a deletion request

Withdraws an open request the bearer filed. Requires a user access token bound to a first-party catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

请求体

| `state` | 是 | string | Set withdrawn to withdraw an open request you filed. 取值：withdrawn |

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/deletion-requests/1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"withdrawn"}'
```

### GET /v2/me/edit-bundle/{object}/{id}

Everything an editor needs to open one entity

One read for an editing screen: the family schema, the entity's snapshot, the bearer's capabilities on it, its edit context and the bearer's quota — each member the exact body its own face answers, so a client swaps five calls for one. The schema and the snapshot decide the answer: an unknown family or entity is 404 as on GET /v2/moderation/snapshots/{object}/{id}. capabilities, context and quota are left out when their own face would have answered an error. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `object` | path | 是 | string | Family of the entity. Unknown family is 404 NOT_FOUND. 取值：work \| company \| character \| release \| tag \| engine \| series \| person \| credit_name \| trait |
| `id` | path | 是 | string | Catalog id of the entity. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/edit-bundle/work/1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### GET /v2/me/edit-capabilities/{object}

What I may edit on one family

Per-field can_propose / can_review / would_automerge for the bearer, evaluated by the editing engine. The capability axis cannot ride on /v2/catalog/schemas/{object}: that face is credential-less and B34 forbids varying one URL's field set by credential, so the two are separate URLs and join on fields[].key. Pass entity_id= for the owner channel, or would_automerge answers the type-level question instead. The answer folds in the bearer's quota: an exhausted tier proposes nothing, and an editor past the daily direct-edit allowance no longer automerges. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `object` | path | 是 | string | Family these capabilities describe. Unknown family is 404 NOT_FOUND. 取值：work \| company \| character \| release \| tag \| engine \| series \| person \| credit_name \| trait |
| `entity_id` | query | 否 | integer (int64) | Evaluate against one entity. Omit for the type-level answer, which cannot express the owner channel: a policy that grants owner-review or owner-automerge answers would_automerge=false without it. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/edit-capabilities/work" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### GET /v2/me/edit-context/{object}/{id}

What an editor sees behind one entity

Per field: the value a proposal is written against, who wrote each scalar column (field provenance, newest first), and, for list fields whose importers keep their own rows, every stored row grouped by source with its identity key, whether it is hidden, whether it is the human lane, plus suppressions whose row is gone. An editor shows what each upstream says from this face and sends rows[].identity in the field's .suppressed companion to hide a row. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `object` | path | 是 | string | Family of the entity. Unknown family is 404 NOT_FOUND. 取值：work \| company \| character \| release \| tag \| engine \| series \| person \| credit_name \| trait |
| `id` | path | 是 | string | Catalog id of the entity. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/edit-context/work/1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### GET /v2/me/edit-quota

My editing quota

The bearer's quota tier and, per counter, the limit, how much of it is used and what remains: proposals filed inside the sliding window, edits applied without review inside it, and proposals still awaiting a decision. Counted per person across every catalog site; the limits are runtime configuration. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

无参数。

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/edit-quota" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### GET /v2/me/folders

List my folders

The bearer user's favorite folders, id-ascending. Requires a user access token with folder:read (folder:write also grants reads).

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：folder:read 或 folder:write

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `contains_work_id` | query | 否 | string | Keep only the folders that already hold this catalog work. This is the add-to-folder picker's question; without it a client had to read every folder it owns and probe each one. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/folders" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### POST /v2/me/folders

Create a folder

Requires a user access token with folder:write.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：folder:write

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | 否 | string | Makes the request safe to retry. The same key with the same body within 24 hours replays the first response with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a retry while the first request is still running is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS. Scoped to the caller and the path. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | 否 | string | Owner's own note. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `is_default` | 否 | boolean | true makes this the user's default folder and clears the flag on the previous holder. |

| `visibility` | 否 | string | Defaults to private. 取值：private \| public |


### GET /v2/me/folders/holdings

Which of my folders hold these works

Membership for up to 100 works in one request: for each work the bearer keeps in at least one folder, the ids of those folders. A work the bearer holds nowhere is left out rather than answered with an empty array, and an id that names no work is simply held nowhere. Folders of every visibility are searched — the bearer owns them all. work_ids is required; this is a batch read with no pagination. Requires a user access token with folder:read (folder:write also grants reads).

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：folder:read 或 folder:write

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `work_ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated work ids, max 100. Batch read, no pagination. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/folders/holdings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### PATCH /v2/me/folders/{id}

Update a folder

Partial update: name, description, visibility, is_default. Requires a user access token with folder:write.

- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>


List a folder's items

Keyset-paginated by updated_at; the final next_cursor can be stored and replayed later as an incremental-sync watermark (deletions are not replayed). Requires a user access token with folder:read (folder:write also grants reads).

| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |

### GET /v2/me/followed-companies

List my followed companies

The bearer user's followed companies, newest follow first. Items carry ids only and are hydrated with /v2/catalog/companies?ids=. company_ids= is a batch read. The list is private to its owner; only the count is public (follower_count on /v2/catalog/companies/{id}). Requires a user access token. Any app may call this; no scope is required.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `company_ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated company ids, max 100. Batch read, no pagination. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/followed-companies" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### PUT /v2/me/followed-companies/{company_id}

Follow a company

No request body. Idempotent: following an already-followed company answers the stored row and writes nothing. Unknown or deleted companies are 404, or the merged-entity problem when the id was merged away. At most 1000 followed companies. Requires a user access token. Any app may call this; no scope is required.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### GET /v2/me/merge-requests

List my merge requests

The bearer's own merge requests, newest first; follow next_cursor for more. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |

| `object` | query | 否 | string | Narrow to one family. 取值：work \| company \| character \| person \| credit_name |
| `origin_site` | query | 否 | string | Narrow to requests filed from one first-party property. 取值：kungal \| moyu \| letmoe \| nextmoe \| editor |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from next_cursor. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | integer (int64) | Page size, 1-100. Default 20. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/merge-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### POST /v2/me/merge-requests

Request a merge

Asks reviewers to merge two entries of one family. Nothing merges on filing: a reviewer approves, the cooling-off runs, then the merge executes through the catalog merge machinery (redirect from source to target, survivorship, archive for unmerge). Two works of different mediums are refused 422. Quotas are tiered: catalog.merge_requests_per_day, _editor, _reviewer inside catalog.write_quota_window_hours; past it 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | 否 | string | Makes the request safe to retry. The same key with the same body within 24 hours replays the first response with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a retry while the first request is still running is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS. Scoped to the caller and the path. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `object` | 是 | string | Family of the two entries. 取值：work \| company \| character \| person \| credit_name |
| `reason` | 是 | string | Why these are the same entry. Reviewers read it. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `source_id` | 是 | string | The entry to fold away. |
| `target_id` | 是 | string | The entry that survives. |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/merge-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"object":"work","reason":"string","source_id":"1","target_id":"1"}'
```

### PATCH /v2/me/merge-requests/{id}

Withdraw a merge request

Withdraws an open request the bearer filed. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | 是 | string | Set withdrawn to withdraw an open request you filed. 取值：withdrawn |

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/merge-requests/1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"withdrawn"}'
```

### POST /v2/me/news

Submit a news item

Any signed-in user may submit to source community (the default): the item lands on pending and goes out once a moderator publishes it, and an account that has used up catalog.news_submissions_per_day inside the sliding window is refused 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED. A partner source must be bound to the bearer and active; its item lands on pending, or straight on published when the source is trusted. Requires a user access token.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | 否 | string | Makes the request safe to retry. The same key with the same body within 24 hours replays the first response with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a retry while the first request is still running is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS. Scoped to the caller and the path. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `banner_hash` | 否 | string | Hash of the banner, as returned by POST /v2/me/news-images. A hash that face did not store is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with reason UNKNOWN_REFERENCE. |
| `body` | 否 | string | The item's own text, CommonMark Markdown, at most 20000 runes (longer is 422 TOO_LONG). Only a community submission may carry one. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `lane` | 否 | string | Section of the source. Defaults to news. 取值：news \| column |
| `published_at` | 否 | string (date-time) | RFC 3339. Defaults to the moment of submission. |
| `source` | 否 | string | News source key. Omit it for community, which any signed-in user may submit to. Any other source must be bound to the bearer as its publisher and active. |
| `source_url` | 否 | string | Canonical link to the original item, an absolute http(s) URL. Required for a partner source, whose attribution always carries a link; optional for an original community submission. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `summary` | 是 | string | The lede. At most 200 runes; longer is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with reason TOO_LONG. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `title` | 是 | string | Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `work_ids` | 否 | string[] | Catalog work ids to link. Stored with manual confidence. |
| `work_ids[]` | 否 | string |  |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/news" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"summary":"string","title":"string"}'
```

### POST /v2/me/news-images

Upload a banner for a news item

multipart/form-data with file: a JPEG, PNG or WebP. Returns the hash a news item carries in banner_hash. A banner has to come from here: POST and PATCH /v2/me/news refuse a hash this face did not store, because bytes held under another site's image client are not kept alive for the news feed. An account that has used up catalog.news_image_uploads_per_day for the UTC day is refused 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Requires a user access token.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | 否 | string | Makes the request safe to retry. The same key with the same body within 24 hours replays the first response with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a retry while the first request is still running is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS. Scoped to the caller and the path. |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/news-images" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### GET /v2/me/news/{id}

Get one of my news items

Carries an ETag for If-Match. Requires a user access token.

- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### PATCH /v2/me/news/{id}

Edit or withdraw one of my news items

A pending or published item may be edited (title/summary/body/source_url/banner_hash/work_ids). A pending edit is scored again; a published edit takes the item off the feed and back to pending until a moderator publishes it again, unless its source is trusted. A published item may be withdrawn with {"status":"withdrawn"} and If-Match. rejected and withdrawn are terminal.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | 是 | string | News item id. |
| `If-Match` | header | 否 | string | Current ETag. Required to withdraw. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `banner_hash` | 否 | string | Hash of the banner, as returned by POST /v2/me/news-images; a hash that face did not store is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with reason UNKNOWN_REFERENCE. The empty string clears the banner. |
| `body` | 否 | string | At most 20000 runes. Only a community submission may carry one; the empty string clears it. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `source_url` | 否 | string | Canonical link to the original item, an absolute http(s) URL. The empty string clears it, which only a community submission may do. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `status` | 否 | string | Only withdrawn. Publishing and rejection happen in the moderation queue, never here. 取值：withdrawn |
| `summary` | 否 | string | At most 200 runes; longer is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with reason TOO_LONG. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `title` | 否 | string | Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `work_ids` | 否 | string[] | Replaces the whole linked-work set. |
| `work_ids[]` | 否 | string |  |

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/news/1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title":"中文版发售日确定"}'
```

### PATCH /v2/me/privacy

Sets the switches the body names and leaves the others as they are; an empty body changes nothing. The change applies to the next read of /v2/work-records. Requires a user access token. Any app may call this; no scope is required.

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"play_records":"private"}'
```

### GET /v2/me/proposals

List my proposals

The bearer's own proposals filed on the token's catalog site; on the central editor (catalog site editor), on every site. state= is a closed vocabulary and an unknown value is 400. object= or entity_type= narrows to one family, entity_id= to one entity — on this lane entity_id= is accepted without a family because every row already belongs to the caller. include=patch (or view=full) adds each row's patch, effective_patch, changed_fields and (open rows) conflict_fields, the same block GET /v2/me/proposals/{id}?include=patch answers, so a list page needs no read per row. field=, has_conflict= and updated_since= filter; sort=filed_desc (default), filed_asc, updated_desc or updated_asc. Requires a user access token. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `state` | query | 否 | string | Closed: open, pending, merged, declined, withdrawn. Unknown value is 400 UNKNOWN_ENUM_VALUE. |
| `object` | query | 否 | string | Closed family filter: work, company, character, release, tag, engine, series, person, credit_name, trait. |
| `entity_type` | query | 否 | string | Editing-engine type, e.g. catalog.work. The same spelling POST /v2/me/proposals takes in its body. Names the same filter as object=; sending both with different families is 400. |
| `entity_id` | query | 否 | string | Catalog id of one entity. Accepted alone on this lane, which is already fenced to the bearer's own proposals; pair it with object= or entity_type= when ids collide across families. |
| `site` | query | 否 | string | Tenant key. Only the central editor (catalog site editor) may name a site other than its own; elsewhere it must equal the token's site or the call is 403 TENANT_MISMATCH. Open vocabulary; unknown values match nothing. |
| `origin_site` | query | 否 | string | Closed: kungal, moyu, letmoe, nextmoe, editor. Keeps proposals filed from that property. Unknown value is 400 UNKNOWN_ENUM_VALUE. |
| `field` | query | 否 | string | A field key such as catalog.work.titles. Keeps proposals whose patch or any amendment names it. |
| `has_conflict` | query | 否 | string | true keeps open proposals that a revision recorded after their base_revision_seq overlaps on a field; false keeps the rest. Only true or false. |
| `updated_since` | query | 否 | string | RFC 3339 UTC ending in Z. Keeps proposals whose updated_at is later. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/proposals" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### POST /v2/me/proposals

File a proposal

Quotas are tiered (user, editor, reviewer; GET /v2/me/edit-quota answers the bearer's): a contributor who has used up their tier's proposal limit inside the sliding window (catalog.proposals_per_day, catalog.proposals_per_day_editor, catalog.proposals_per_day_reviewer), or who already has their tier's most proposals awaiting a decision (catalog.open_proposals_max_*), is refused 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED. An editor past catalog.direct_edits_per_day_editor still files, but the proposal queues for review instead of applying. Requires a user access token bound to a catalog site. The token must carry the catalog:edit scope.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | 否 | string | Makes the request safe to retry. The same key with the same body within 24 hours replays the first response with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a retry while the first request is still running is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS. Scoped to the caller and the path. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entity_id` | 是 | string | Target catalog id. |
| `entity_type` | 是 | string | Editing-engine type, e.g. catalog.work. Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `note` | 否 | string | Must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `patch` | 是 | map<string, object> | Field-key to new value. |
| `patch.«key»` | 否 | object |  |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/proposals" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"entity_id":"1","entity_type":"string","patch":{"key":"string"}}'
```

| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks: amendments, patch. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. full adds amendments and patch. |

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### PATCH /v2/me/proposals/{id}

- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>

### GET /v2/me/ratings

List my ratings

The bearer user's ratings, in the order the catalog last changed them, oldest first; next_cursor is the incremental-sync watermark. work_ids= is a batch read. A rating is one per person per work across every NextMoe site, so this answers what the user rated anywhere. Requires a user access token. Any app may call this; no scope is required.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | 否 | string | Opaque keyset cursor from a prior next_cursor. Must start with cur_. |
| `limit` | query | 否 | string | Page size 1-100, default 20. Values above 100 are 400 LIMIT_TOO_LARGE, not clamped. |
| `view` | query | 否 | string | basic (default) or full. Closed vocabulary. |
| `include` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated blocks. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_INCLUDE. |
| `fields` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated top-level keys after view/include. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. object and id are always kept. |
| `ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated ids, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `refs` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated source:external_id, max 100. Batch lane: no pagination. |
| `include_total` | query | 否 | string | true to include total. Only true or false. |
| `facets` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated facet names. Unknown token is 400 UNKNOWN_FACET. |
| `sort` | query | 否 | string | Closed per-collection sort key. |
| `nsfw` | query | 否 | string | true includes r18. false or absent hides r18. Only true or false. |
| `work_ids` | query | 否 | string | Comma-separated work ids, max 100. Batch read, no pagination. |

```bash
curl "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/ratings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### PUT /v2/me/ratings/{work_id}

Rate a work, or replace my rating of it

Creates the rating or replaces every field of it; the id, client_id and site stay those of the first write. Sending the rating as it already stands writes nothing. The work's nextmoe score on /v2/catalog/works/{id}/ratings follows at once. Any app may write a rating; it is public on every site. A first-party site checks short_summary itself before sending it. For a third-party application's token the catalog checks a new or changed short_summary: a refused one is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED at /short_summary with reason NOT_ALLOWED_VALUE, and nothing is written. Requires a user access token; no scope is required.

- 所属 API：Public API v2（/v2）
- 鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <用户访问令牌>
- scope：无需凭据

| 参数 | 位置 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `work_id` | path | 是 | string | Catalog work id. |

请求体

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aspect_scores` | 否 | object |  |
| `aspect_scores.art` | 否 | integer (int64) | Absent or null when not rated. |
| `aspect_scores.character` | 否 | integer (int64) | Absent or null when not rated. |
| `aspect_scores.music` | 否 | integer (int64) | Absent or null when not rated. |
| `aspect_scores.replay_value` | 否 | integer (int64) | Absent or null when not rated. |
| `aspect_scores.route` | 否 | integer (int64) | Absent or null when not rated. |
| `aspect_scores.story` | 否 | integer (int64) | Absent or null when not rated. |
| `aspect_scores.system` | 否 | integer (int64) | Absent or null when not rated. |
| `aspect_scores.voice` | 否 | integer (int64) | Absent or null when not rated. |
| `overall` | 是 | integer (int64) | The overall score, a whole number from 1 to 10. |
| `recommend` | 是 | string | How strongly the author recommends the work. 取值：strong_no \| no \| neutral \| yes \| strong_yes |
| `short_summary` | 否 | string | Short review, plain text. Absent or empty means none. Free text; must not be used as a discriminant. |
| `spoiler_level` | 否 | string | How much short_summary gives away. Absent means none. 取值：none \| portion \| serious |

```bash
curl -X PUT "https://api.nextmoe.dev/v2/me/ratings/1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"aspect_scores":{"art":8,"character":8,"music":9,"replay_value":8,"route":7,"story":8,"system":7,"voice":8},"overall":8,"recommend":"yes","short_summary":"画面和音乐都很出色，主线一周目通关后还想再走一遍。","spoiler_level":"none"}'
```

204 with no body, also when there was none. The deletion reaches /v2/ratings/changes as a gone entry. Requires a user access token. Any app may call this; no scope is required.

- scope：无需凭据
